detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Build trains

There are more than 30 models of railroad cars, locomotives and train stations.

Connect your population

The population will produce more work and science if it is close to train stations connected to densely populated ones.

Connect your productive buildings

Connecting an iron mine to the steelworks will increase production. So will other pairs of buildings, such as sawmills with lumber camps, etc.
